selection_policy: Exactly three existing review_required programme-domain candidates from the small ccmas external-complements audit; official sources may corroborate or verify an edge, but no unsupported edge is promoted.

sources.title: University of Ilorin, Department of Psychology: Curriculum & Program
sources.evidence_locator: Lines 0-4 identify the Department of Psychology; lines 23-25 place its B.Sc. Psychology programme in the Faculty of Social Sciences and describe its curriculum and methods.

records.evidence_summary: The official University of Ilorin department page identifies Psychology as a B.Sc. programme in the Faculty of Social Sciences and describes its curriculum, experiments, practicum and psychological analysis. This verifies the programme's functional Social Sciences context without creating a new role or tool claim.
records.limitation: This batch records verified external evidence; it does not alter the canonical seed or live student payload.

sources.title: University of Ibadan Department of Political Science: Courses
sources.evidence_locator: Lines 176-182 list POS 217 Introduction to Public Administration as a compulsory 200-level Political Science course; lines 207-216 and 225-226 show further administration and public-sector content.

records.evidence_summary: The official University of Ibadan Political Science course catalogue places Introduction to Public Administration inside the B.Sc. Political Science curriculum and also lists Public Administration in Nigeria and public-sector administration content. This is direct programme-course evidence for a functional Political Science to Public Administration connection.
records.limitation: The evidence verifies the relationship candidate but does not itself define every downstream role or qualification in the Public Administration domain.

sources.title: National Universities Commission: BMAS Law draft
sources.evidence_locator: PDF page 50, lines 2326-2337: Law Programme clinical and moot-court requirements and legal research, writing and advocacy training.

sources.title: Godfrey Okoye University: LL.B Law CCMAS curriculum
sources.evidence_locator: PDF pages 0-2, lines 3-29 and 39-43: LL.B Law curriculum, Common Law objectives, legal practice preparation and the relationship of Common, Statutory, Customary and Islamic law systems.

records.evidence_summary: The official NUC and university law curricula establish legal-practice preparation, clinical training, research, advocacy and the presence of Islamic law among legal systems. They do not provide an exact reviewed curriculum for the combined Common and Islamic Law programme row, so the candidate remains review_required and is not promoted.
records.limitation: Evidence supports the Legal Practice domain and law-family context, but the exact combined-programme curriculum anchor is not established by these sources.
